## Conclusion

The decomposition attributes eligibility to category design, teacher error, test error, and the test menu.
Category design remains the largest component across the feasible anchors examined in @sec-sensitivity; the relative contributions of teacher and test error depend on the assumed resit share.
The explorer makes these model results comparable across the Netherlands and the schools and groups represented in the data.

The error split transfers one simulated resit share from the 2022 Centrale Eindtoets to Lib paper.
The common factor measures what teacher and test share, rather than an independent truth; teacher “error” can include information the test does not capture.
Teacher and test errors may also be correlated, for example through a shared assessment provider, contrary to the model's independence assumption.
Finally, the CvTE tables cover only 61–69% of test participants and include special education, whereas our DUO school analysis uses regular schools.
